generation_rule: Generate the literal product of preparation, probe, retention, closure, record, poststate, reconstruction and replication forms; decide all 256 only from admitted observation, information-loss, state-transition and resolved molecular-state laws.
grammar_boundary: Every positive finite molecular preparation/readout sequence and its retained instrument/condition boundary, tested against the complete nine-file NIST MDS2-3389 CaH+ package containing 330 data rows and 796 cells.
